title: IBM 4361/MVT exact project evidence and maturity
summary: Checkpoint-indexed exact guest states, artifact identities, qualification counts, next frontiers and evidence maturity. This corpus is deliberately separate from IBM architecture facts.
rules: Use checkpoint=... or opcode=... typed lookup to recover exact project state.
SEALED_CHECKPOINT requires artifact identity plus manifest/fresh-extraction completion.
GUEST_AND_PERMANENT_REPLAY_QUALIFIED may guide continued work but must not be represented as a sealed package.
UNTOUCHED_FRONTIER records are navigation fences, not semantic classifications.
